milestones.title: The Pressed Sheet, the graphics overhaul
milestones.notes: Owner kept the Same Map concept but rejected the graphics (boring, wants 3D integrated with the 2D maps, camera zooms, faster charts, a rethought bottom timeline, every map checked). Council of six lenses converged on one chassis, THE PRESSED SHEET (design/R10/council-verdict.md, binding): the map is a printed survey sheet on a cream-dark desk; grades press DOWN in four quantized rank steps (the press stamps at a3-s2 with an on-page disclosure), only true dollars rise UP (act6 towers at Lawndale and East Woodlawn); FLIP hybrid camera with named real-geometry focus targets, counter-scaled type, veil spotlights, quantized tilt (0/10/22, mobile 8) at exactly three events; ground plane rebuilt from real layers (community-areas land and fabric, derived shoreline lake with water-lining, parks, PLSS mile grid). Wave 0 (commit 0fccc88) landed the core; Wave 1 agents rebuilt the register (union band, corrected batons, rust-only-2026 caret) and the act6 towers.
